published.description: online when the device connects. offline when it shuts down cleanly or when the broker loses it (last will).
Product probe, one decimal. nan when the probe does not answer.
Cabinet air probe, one decimal. nan when the probe does not answer.
Room probe, one decimal. nan when the probe does not answer.
HC-SR04 distance to the door, three decimals, median of the last second. nan when there is no echo.
Received signal strength of the Wi-Fi connection.
Seconds since boot. Drops back after a reboot or an OTA update.
ON after the product stays above -12 °C for 10 minutes. OFF 1 minute after it drops back. Published only when it changes.
ON when the distance stays above the closed baseline plus 0.05 m for 2 s, or when there is no echo. OFF 1 s after it drops back. Not published while the baseline is 0. Published only when it changes.
Closed-door distance set by the calibration or by command. 0 means not calibrated. Stored in flash.
Buzzer output on GPIO25. Follows the local alarm unless commanded.
Broker address in use. Stored in flash.
Probe polling interval, 5 to 300 in steps of 5. Stored in flash.
Device log lines at the firmware log level, with ANSI colors.

commands.description: Turns the buzzer on or off.
Samples the door distance for 3 s and stores the median as the closed distance. Keeps the old value if fewer than 5 valid samples arrive.
Sets the closed-door distance in meters, 0 to 4. Stored in flash.
Changes the broker address and reconnects. Stored in flash.
Changes the probe polling interval in seconds, 5 to 300 in steps of 5. Stored in flash.

outside_prefix.description: Published by ESPHome on every connection, retained. JSON with the device IP addresses, MAC, ESPHome version and board. Not checked by the server.
